open.title: Add improvement idea to bug report
open.description: This is an improvement idea for the bug report / support workflow on sthopwood.com. The goal is to enhance the bug report submission experience by allowing users to attach improvement ideas directly to a bug report, or to link related improvement ideas to an existing bug report.
open.steps: 1. Add a field in the bug report form that lets users optionally attach or link an improvement idea to the report. 2. Allow linking an existing improvement idea to a bug report so related items stay connected. 3. Display linked improvement ideas on the bug report detail view.

open.actual: Currently bug reports and improvement ideas are handled separately with no way to link them together.

open.title: Reduce the bug report requirements
open.description: The bug report submission form currently requires too many fields, which creates friction and discourages users from submitting bug reports. The form should be simplified to reduce the number of required fields, making it faster and easier for users to report issues.
open.steps: 1. Review the current bug report form fields and identify which are truly essential. 2. Make only the title and description fields required. 3. Convert severity, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior to optional fields. 4. Add helpful placeholder text to guide users filling out optional fields. 5. Test the simplified form to ensure it works correctly.
open.expected: Users should be able to submit a bug report with minimal required fields (e.g., just a title and description), with optional fields for severity, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
open.actual: The bug report form currently requires multiple fields (title, description, severity, steps, expected, actual), which makes submission tedious and may discourage users from reporting bugs.
